title: Butane - Specific Heat vs. Temperature and Pressure
description: Calculate isobaric (Cp) and isochoric (Cv) specific heat of butane at varying temperature and pressure conditions. The tool provides specific heat values in multiple units (kJ/mol K, kJ/kg K, Wh/(kg K), kcal/(kg K), Btu(IT)/lb °F) for liquid, gas, and supercritical phase states.
